title: Polynomial-time computability of the doubling loop
statement: The function on bit strings obtained by applying the doubling step $2(|z|+1)$ times to the encoded pair whose first component is $1$ and whose second component is the concatenation of $0$ with the first component of the result of applying the counting step $|z|+1$ times to the encoded pair of the empty string and $z$ is polynomial-time computable.
